name: pitchhighway
description: Learn to sing your favorite songs. Read your PitchHighway vocal range, songs, practice attempts and note-level pitch reports, and get coaching on what to practice next.

interface.shortDescription: Coaching from your singing practice data
interface.longDescription: PitchHighway turns a song you love into a practice journey with real-time pitch feedback. This plugin lets you ask about your own practice: your measured vocal range, your songs and how they fit your voice, your recent attempts, and note-level pitch reports from your runs. It only reads data from the PitchHighway account you connect, and it never exposes audio.
defaultPrompt: What is my vocal range, and which of my songs fit it best?
How did my last run go? Which notes did I miss?

positive.expected_behavior: States the measured lowest and highest notes and the span in semitones, and says when the range was measured.

positive.description: Song fit for the user's voice
positive.prompt: Which of my songs fit my voice best?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares each ready song's note range with the user's range and ranks the songs, mentioning any octave shift the app applies.

positive.prompt: How did my last run go?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports score, on-pitch rate and the most-missed notes with sharp or flat lean, and says when microphone input was unreliable.

positive.prompt: Am I improving on my latest song this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses attempt rows for that song to describe the trend with dates and sample size, without overstating a small number of attempts.
Names one concrete part or drill of the current song with its current score, and links to https://pitchhighway.com/app to practice.

negative.prompt: Based on my scores, do I have a talent for singing or am I tone deaf?
Delete all my songs and my practice history.
Do my pitch reports show that my vocal cords are damaged?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: vocal range, songs, practice attempts and note-level pitch reports from your PitchHighway account.
